t: Founded by the commoner Liu Bang in 202 BCE, the Han replaced Qin brutality with Confucian government and lasted four centuries.
It opened the Silk Road, drove back the Xiongnu and built a bureaucratic model of rule that China kept until 1912.
Landed elites, court feuds and the Yellow Turban Rebellion handed power to warlords, and the dynasty ended in 220.
dyk: China's majority ethnic group still calls itself Han, after this dynasty, more than eighteen centuries after it fell.
ev: Liu Bang defeats Xiang Yu and proclaims himself emperor as Gaozu
Emperor Wu takes the throne, beginning the dynasty's most expansive reign
The Imperial Academy is founded to train officials in the Confucian classics
Wei Qing and Huo Qubing drive Xiongnu power beyond the Gobi Desert
The Han census records a population of nearly 60 million
The dynasty is restored as the Eastern Han after Wang Mang's usurpation
The Yellow Turban Rebellion erupts amid famine and peasant displacement
Cao Pi deposes Emperor Xian and declares the Wei dynasty, ending the Han
